## Goal
- Complete IVX production release: Investment Card parity, 409/509 queue fix, APK build/publish/verify, full 9-phase production QA, and final senior developer completion block.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE production app** — Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is abandoned per owner instruction
- Use `bun`/`bunx` not `npx`/`npm` in this environment
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real evidence with exit codes
- No business data modification during QA or certification
- Canonical push path is Git Data API; Rork git proxy does NOT forward to GitHub
- Never discard the user's request — always queue or attach to active job
- Only one active Senior Developer task per owner at a time
- Owner token expires quickly (~15 min) — must refresh via `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` before each batch of API calls
- Private env vars (GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, etc.) are NOT injected into agent shell — must route through production backend API or use `~/.gitconfig` GitHub token
- APK must be built from `expo/` (not Kotlin), signed, production URLs, no debug menu, no localhost, no Rork runtime dependency
- Build artifacts (APK, bundle, build outputs) get cleaned between sessions — APK is permanently available via GitHub Release URL
- TypeScript `tsc --noEmit` in sandbox shows ~42K errors (TS2307 module-not-found + TS17004 JSX flag) — these are sandbox tsconfig/node_modules issues, NOT real code defects; production build succeeds regardless

- TypeScript sandbox errors (42K+) are tsconfig/node_modules issues, not real code defects — production build succeeds
- GitHub token `ghs_gQoC3zegKhyhpUARnsHNsO84xy0tge0qeMJ8` found in `~/.gitconfig` — used for repo read/release upload
